info.title: StreamFi API
info.description: Machine-readable spec for the tips, streams and users route groups. Maintained by hand; npm test fails if a route is added, removed or changes methods without this file being updated. See docs/api/README.md.

get.description: Ranked by viewers; followed streams first when viewer_wallet is given. `streams` mirrors `items` for existing clients.

post.summary: Create a short-lived tip price quote
post.description: Locks the XLM/USD rate for 5 minutes. Send x-correlation-id to tie this call to the rest of the tip flow.

post.summary: Recompute a creator's tip totals from the ledger

202.description: Full history still being counted in the background

post.summary: Submit a tip, optionally against a quote token

post.description: Usernames are NFKC-normalized and lowercased. Mixed-script names and names that are visually confusable with an existing username are rejected with 400.

400.description: Invalid input, username taken, or username too similar to an existing one

get.summary: List users with the most followers

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size; clamped to the endpoint maximum. See docs/api/pagination.md.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

CorrelationId.name: x-correlation-id
CorrelationId.description: One ID per user action, echoed back and included in every server log line.
